sentences.text:
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail relating to Crime No.55/2021 registered at Police Station - Maharajpura, District - Gwalior (M.P.)
for the offence under Section 420 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 28.10.2024.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed, therefore, there is no requirement of further custodial interrogation of the applicant.
The offence is triable by JMFC.
As per the allegation, applicant has obtained Rs.3,00,000/- from the complainant on the pretext of selling a plot.
As per the allegation, a sum of Rs.3,00,000/- is remained to be paid to the complainant.

Applicant undertakes to pay Rs.1,00,000/- to the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:22156 2 MCRC-53323-2024 complainant at the time of furnishing surety and rest of the amount within two months from the date of his release.
He is ready and willing to abide by all the terms and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On these grounds, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection on Dinesh Chandra Shrivas vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87571305/

opennyai_summary.decision:
He is in custody since 28.10.2024.
The offence is triable by JMFC.
As per the allegation, a sum of Rs.3,00,000/- is remained to be paid to the complainant.
Applicant undertakes to pay Rs.1,00,000/- to the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:22156 2 MCRC-53323-2024 complainant at the time of furnishing surety and rest of the amount within two months from the date of his release.
He is ready and willing to abide by all the terms and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
On these grounds, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties and attending facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One Lac Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant:-
1) The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;
2) The applicant will cooperate in the investigation/trial, as the case may be;
3) The applicant will not indulge himself in extending inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:22156 3 MCRC-53323-2024 dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to the Police Officer, as the case may be;
4) The applicant will not commit any other offence or will not repeat the offence in future.
In case, if he is found involved in the offence of same nature, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to the Bench.
5) The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial;
6) The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be;
7) The applicant shall pay Rs.1,00,000/- to the complainant at the time of furnishing surety and remaining amount i.e. Rs.2,00,000/- within a period of sixty days from the date of his release.
In case of any default, this order shall stand cancelled forthwith.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
